s1.syndrome_frame: Painless swelling in the parotid region with a mobile mass and cystic lesion
salient_findings: Painless, non-erythematous, mobile, round mass in the right parotid region
Cystic lesion with irregular edges and acoustic enhancement on ultrasonography
Cystic background with dirty necrosis and pseudopapillary clusters of moderately atypical cells on fine-needle aspiration
key_facts: 63-year-old Caucasian man
History of smoking
History of cardiovascular disease
1-month history of right cheek swelling
Afebrile
Painless, non-erythematous, mobile, round mass (~2 cm) in the right parotid region
Ultrasonography showed a single lobulated, well-circumscribed, hypoechogenic cystic lesion
Irregular edges and acoustic enhancement in the superficial parenchyma of the right parotid gland
Echogenic foci suggested debris
Ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration yielded a cystic background with dirty necrosis
Pseudopapillary clusters of moderately atypical cells with cyanophilic cytoplasm
Specimen classified as category V (suspicious for malignancy) by the Milan System
Contrast-enhanced CT showed a homogeneously enhancing nodular lesion in the superficial lobe of the right parotid gland
Thin fibrous capsule surrounding the lesion
No suspicious cervical lymph nodes or thoracic lesions

shortlist.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Cystic lesion with dirty necrosis and pseudopapillary clusters of moderately atypical cells

shortlist.label: Salivary duct carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Initially considered based on ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration and Milan System classification

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Most common benign salivary gland tumor, consistent with mobile, well-circumscribed mass

shortlist.label: Warthin tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Common benign salivary gland tumor, consistent with cystic lesion and moderately atypical cells

shortlist.label: Acinic cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Less common malignant salivary gland tumor, consistent with cystic lesion and atypical cells

raw.rationale: The presence of a cystic background with 'dirty' necrosis and pseudopapillary clusters of moderately atypical cells with cyanophilic cytoplasm in the fine-needle aspiration specimen, along with the ultrasonography findings of a lobulated, well-circumscribed, hypoechogenic cystic lesion, is more consistent with mucoepidermoid carcinoma, which can present with a range of cytological atypia and necrosis.

rejected.label: Salivary duct carcinoma
rejected.why: While initially considered, salivary duct carcinoma typically presents with more aggressive features and a higher likelihood of lymph node involvement, which is not seen in this case.

rejected.label: Pleomorphic adenoma
rejected.why: Pleomorphic adenoma is the most common benign salivary gland tumor, but the cytological findings of atypia and necrosis are not typical for this entity.

rejected.label: Warthin tumor
rejected.why: Warthin tumor typically presents with a characteristic papillary-cystic architecture and oncocytic cells, which are not described in the fine-needle aspiration specimen.

rejected.label: Acinic cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Acinic cell carcinoma is a rare tumor that can present with a range of cytological features, but the presence of 'dirty' necrosis and pseudopapillary clusters is more suggestive of mucoepidermoid carcinoma.
